examples.text: te kilesā pavaḍḍhantā, āvisanti bahuṃ janaṃ, kīḷanti m'aññe bālehi, ummattehi'va rakkhasā.

76884.meaning1: war against oneself; battle with oneself
76884.commentary: (THa) sasaṅgāme'va ghosite'ti hiraññasuvaṇṇamaṇimutt'ādikaṃ dhanaṃ vippakiritvā yaṃ yaṃ hiraññasuvaṇṇ'ādi yassa yassa hatthagataṃ, taṃ taṃ tassa tass'eva hotū'ti evaṃ kāmaghosanā sasaṅgāmaghosanā nāma. tatth'āyam'attho, kilesavatthūsu yo yo kileso yaṃ yaṃ sattaṃ gaṇhāti abhibhavati, so so tassa tassa hotū'ti kilesasenāpatinā mārena sasaṅgāme ghosite viya. tehi tehi kilesehi abhibhūtā te bālaputhujjanā tena tena ārammaṇabhāgena vidhāvitā vositā'ti.

examples.text: kileseh'ābhibhūtā te, tena tena vidhāvitā, narā kilesavatthūsu, sasaṅgāme'va ghosite.

76885.commentary: (THa) sasaṅgāme'va ghosite'ti hiraññasuvaṇṇamaṇimutt'ādikaṃ dhanaṃ vippakiritvā yaṃ yaṃ hiraññasuvaṇṇ'ādi yassa yassa hatthagataṃ, taṃ taṃ tassa tass'eva hotū'ti evaṃ kāmaghosanā sasaṅgāmaghosanā nāma. tatth'āyam'attho, kilesavatthūsu yo yo kileso yaṃ yaṃ sattaṃ gaṇhāti abhibhavati, so so tassa tassa hotū'ti kilesasenāpatinā mārena sasaṅgāme ghosite viya. tehi tehi kilesehi abhibhūtā te bālaputhujjanā tena tena ārammaṇabhāgena vidhāvitā vositā'ti.

examples.text: kileseh'ābhibhūtā te, tena tena vidhāvitā, narā kilesavatthūsu, sasaṅgāme'va ghosite.

76886.meaning1: for the sake of a spoonful of alms
76886.commentary: (THa) kaṭacchubhikkhahetū'pī'ti kaṭacchumatta-bhikkhā-nimittam'pi. taṃ dadantassa gahaṭṭhassa ananulomikasaṃsaggavasena akiccāni pabbajitena akattabbāni kammāni nisevare karonti.

examples.text: dhanañ'ca puttaṃ bhariyañ'ca, chaḍḍayitvāna niggatā, kaṭacchubhikkhahetū'pi, akicchāni nisevare

76887.meaning1: blamed by the teacher; criticized by the master

examples.text: udar'āvadehakaṃ bhutvā, sayant'uttānaseyyakā, kathaṃ vattenti paṭibuddhā, yā kathā satthugarahitā, avūpasantā ajjhattaṃ, sāmaññ'attho'ti acchati.

76888.meaning1: all the artisan's crafts; all the craftsman's skills
76888.commentary: (THa) sabbakārukasippānī'ti sabbehi vess'ādīhi kārukehi kattabbāni bhattatālavaṇṭakaraṇ'ādīni hatthasippāni.

examples.text: sabbakārukasippāni, cittiṃ katvāna sikkhare, avūpasantā ajjhattaṃ, sāmaññ'attho'ti acchati.

76889.meaning1: having given value; having given importance; having given high regard

examples.text: sabbakārukasippāni, cittīkatvāna sikkhare, avūpasantā ajjhattaṃ, sāmaññ'attho'ti acchati.
mattikaṃ telacuṇṇañ'ca, udak'āsanabhojanaṃ, gihīnaṃ upanāmenti, ākaṅkhantā bahuttaraṃ.
mattikaṃ telacuṇṇañ'ca, udak'āsanabhojanaṃ, gihīnaṃ upanāmenti, ākaṅkhantā bahuttaraṃ.

76892.commentary: (THa) ākaṅkhantā bahuttaran'ti bahuṃ piṇḍapāt'ādiuttar'uttaraṃ ākaṅkhantā amhehi mattik'ādīsu dinnesu manussā daḷhabhattikā hutvā bahuṃ uttar'uttaraṃ catupaccayajātaṃ dassantī'ti adhippāyena gihīnaṃ upanāmentī'ti attho.

examples.text: mattikaṃ telacuṇṇañ'ca, udak'āsanabhojanaṃ, gihīnaṃ upanāmenti, ākaṅkhantā bahuttaraṃ.

76893.meaning1: edible food; raw food; non-staple food (e.g. vegetables, sweets)

examples.text: dantaponaṃ kapitthañ'ca, pupphaṃ khādaniyāni ca, piṇḍapāte ca sampanne, ambe āmalakāni ca.

76894.commentary: (THa) saṅghalābhassa bhaṇḍantī'ti saṅghalābhahetu bhaṇḍanti mayhaṃ pāpuṇāti, na tuyhan'ti-ādinā kalahaṃ karonti.

examples.text: saṅghalābhassa bhaṇḍanti, saṅghato paribāhirā, paralābh'opajīvantā, ahirīkā na lajjare.

76895.meaning1: living on; living off; subsisting on
76895.commentary: (THa) paralābh'opajīvantā'ti sāsane lābhassa andhabālaputhujjanehi pare sīl'ādiguṇasampanne sekkhe uddissa uppannattā taṃ paralābhaṃ, parato vā dāyakato laddhabbalābhaṃ upajīvantā

examples.text: saṅghalābhassa bhaṇḍanti, saṅghato paribāhirā, paralābha-upajīvantā, ahirīkā na lajjare.

76896.meaning1: fixated on gain and honour; infatuated with acquisitions and esteem

examples.text: n'ānuyuttā tathā eke, muṇḍā saṅghāṭipārutā, sambhāvanaṃ'y'ev'icchanti, lābhasakkāramucchitā.

76897.meaning1: progressed; become; gone on; come to
76897.commentary: (THa) nānappayātamhī'ti nānappakāre bhedanadhamme payāte samakate, nānappakārena vā saṃkilesadhamme payātuṃ pavattituṃ āraddhe.

examples.text: evaṃ nānappayātamhi, na dāni sukaraṃ tathā, aphusitaṃ vā phusituṃ, phusitaṃ v'ānurakkhituṃ.
pārāpariyo das'ete, vīsamhi parikittitā, gāthāyo dve satā honti, pañcatālīsa uttarin'ti.

76899.meaning1: having what interest? with what desire?
76899.commentary: (THa) kiṃ chandā'ti imasmiṃ sāsane anāgate bhikkhū kīdisacchandā kīdis'ādhimuttikā, kiṃ hīn'ādhimuttikā, udāhu paṇīt'ādhimuttikā'ti attho.

examples.text: kiṃchandā kim'adhippāyā, kim'ākappā bhavissare, anāgatamhi kālamhi, taṃ me akkhāhi pucchito.
